# Vahan Bedros

> Vahan Bedros is a public speaking and voice coach in Vancouver, BC. He coaches entrepreneurs one on one, founded Temple of Speak (a 10-week, in-person public speaking program, started in 2024), teaches public speaking, and leads a weekly men's circle. He has spent ten years at the front of a classroom, first in Montreal and now in Vancouver.

One-on-one coaching covers interview prep, presentation delivery for leaders, pitching for entrepreneurs, and being heard in everyday life.

Speaking topics: communicating ideas with impact, overcoming speaking anxiety from the inside, storytelling and stage presence.

## Pages

- [Vahan Bedros](https://vahanbedros.com/): who Vahan is, his teaching, talks and podcasts, and four ways to work with him (one-on-one coaching, Temple of Speak, the Brotherhood, guest speaking)
- [Temple of Speak](https://vahanbedros.com/temple-of-speak/): the 10-week, in-person program in Vancouver, once a week for three hours. Weeks 1-6 give emotions a voice, with voice control and body language; weeks 7-10 are your story and a vision talk. The next cohort starts in January 2027.
- [Brotherhood](https://vahanbedros.com/brotherhood/): a weekly men's circle in Vancouver for honest speech and accountability. Joining starts with a free 30-minute call; there are no drop-in visits.
